messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered — HIGH error rate detected for inference-gateway-prod-west1. Metric: http.5xx_rate >= 1.5% for 3m. Links: <https://pagerduty.example/incident/PD12345|PD12345>
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 created and notified oncall. Auto-escalation in 8m if unacked.
alex_chang: acked. digging in now, pinging infra. seeing spike across frontend->gateway path.
maya_rao: on it too, pulling dashboards. can you dump a quick tail of gateway logs?
alex_chang: running: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-gateway --since=10m | grep 5.. | head -n 200`
alex_chang: logs show repeated `502: upstream read timeout` from grpc-client to kvcache-service, + elevated connection resets. sample: ```2026-02-27T02:02:13Z inference-gateway ERROR req_id=abc123 upstream=10.3.7.12:5042 error="read tcp 10.3.7.9:443->10.3.7.12:5042: read: connection reset by peer" status=502 latency=120ms```
samir_patel: seeing large number of `kvcache` evictions around the same time in prometheus: `kvcache_evictions_total` spikes. could be memory pressure + GC.
lina_gomez: confirmed, dedicated-kvcache-east1 shows increasing OOM kills in pod events for the last 4m. pushing a scaling suggestion.
maya_rao: customers impacted? quick check on request distribution — 98% of callers OK, but a specific traffic slice (region=ap-east, model=redwood-small) has 20% 5xx. raising customer-impact flag.
alex_chang: temporary mitigation plan: 1) route traffic away from affected kvcache cluster 2) increase kvcache replicas 3) enable degraded-mode cache bypass for critical routes 4) roll forward bypass for model variant. I'll try route weight change first.
oncall-rotation: handoff note: alex_chang (ack) -> maya_rao (taking lead in 5m if still hot).
pagerduty-bot: PD note: ack recorded by alex_chang at 1726225378.
alex_chang: updating loadbalancer weights: `./infractl traffic shift set --service=kvcache --from=prod-west1 --to=prod-east1 --pct=80`
alex_chang: console shows gradual weight move starting. monitoring errors.
maya_rao: while weights move, triggering scale-up: `kubectl -n prod scale statefulset/kvcache --replicas=6` and increasing memory requests on the ASG template for kvcache.
lina_gomez: issuing cluster-side hotfix: bumping JVM heap on kvcache nodes + restart on one pod to avoid full cluster restart. Doing rolling restarts.
samir_patel: sending warmup traffic to new replicas to populate KV quickly: `curl -X POST https://internal-warmup/prod/warm?prefix=kv`
alex_chang: observed 5xx rate fall from 1.8% -> 0.4% over 2 minutes after traffic shift. Great.
maya_rao: but watch out: increased latency slightly for east1 callers ~ +60ms. acceptable trade for now.
oncall-rotation: escalation window passed; no auto-escalation triggered.
pagerduty-bot: PD update: Incident PD12345 status = acknowledged, responders = alex_chang, maya_rao.
lina_gomez: digging into root cause: GC churn due to recent config change that reduced off-heap buffer. Opening a follow-up PR to revert and add canary.
alex_chang: operators note: temporarily enabled cache-bypass for model=redwood-small in prod-west1 to prevent downstream errors. config: `cache.bypass["redwood-small"] = true`
maya_rao: customer comms: ops - low blast: affected subset saw increased 502s for ~7 minutes, now mitigated by reroute/scale. Probable root cause: kvcache memory pressure after config change; follow-up audit + postmortem planned.
samir_patel: quick checklist for post-incident: 1) revert offending config in canary 2) add autoscaler for kvcache memory usage 3) add alert for rapid eviction spikes 4) improve PD runbook to include traffic shift play.
alex_chang: pushing a short-lived dashboard snapshot: <https://dashboards.example.org/d/abc/inference-gateway?orgId=1&from=now-30m|gateway-5xx-snapshot>
incident-bot: Note: automatic anomaly detector also flagged an uptick in retries from clients using older SDK; consider patching client-side retry backoff in next SDK release.
maya_rao: handoff: i'll own the follow-up and postmortem. tagging @oncall-rotation to rotate schedule if needed.
oncall-rotation: acknowledged. I'll update rotation doc and schedule a 1-hour post-incident review at 1300 UTC.
alex_chang: leaving a short runbook snippet for field ops: ```If 5xx spike from kvcache: 1) check kvcache_evictions_total 2) shift lb weight away from cluster 3) scale replicas 4) enable model cache-bypass 5) monitor 5xx and latency```
lina_gomez: PR to revert config opened: <https://git.example/redwood/kvcache/pull/987|#987>. tagging SRE and infra.
maya_rao: current status update for PD: mitigated, monitoring. will transition to post-incident follow-up. closing on-call action but keeping incident open for postmortem tracking.
pagerduty-bot: PD update: Incident PD12345 marked as mitigated at 1726225590 by maya_rao.
alex_chang: short note for customers in case SOC asks: "We observed a brief 5xx spike impacting a small subset of traffic; traffic was rerouted and services scaled to mitigate; full service restored within ~10 minutes; a postmortem will follow."
maya_rao: thanks everyone. will post the postmortem draft in #postmortems and link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
